•    Manage department resource levels effectively, balancing client demand, team wellbeing, delivery quality, profitability and growth opportunities.
•    Develop the global hub relationship, actively improving the range, complexity and quality of tasks the hub can support, while increasing utilisation and embedding clear ways of working.

Develop, evolve and champion our market-leading Paid Search proposition
•    Define and own the strategic vision for Paid Search across the relevant client portfolio and team, ensuring our approach remains industry-leading, commercially differentiated and aligned to evolving client, consumer and platform behaviours.
•    Own channel excellence for the team, setting clear standards for planning, activation, optimisation, governance, testing, measurement, reporting and client-facing recommendations.
•    Support the development and execution of the Paid Search proposition and product strategy and roadmap, including new services, frameworks, operating models and best practice approaches that can scale across clients and MM&D UK.
•    Champion the use of AI, automation and technology-enabled solutions in a scalable way, developing innovative client-specific solutions that create competitive advantage and unlock new growth opportunities.
•    Ensure the team remains at the forefront of innovation across Google, Microsoft, retail media, social search, search marketplaces, emerging search engines and AI-driven search experiences.
•    Translate broader client business challenges into Paid Search strategies that address growth, profitability, customer acquisition, demand generation, retention, conversion, market share and customer experience objectives.

•    Support the evolution of Integrated Search and the broader Total Search approach, connecting Paid Search, Organic Search, content strategy, AI search optimisation and measurement into a more joined-up client proposition.
•    Contribute to wider MM&D UK delivery initiatives, narratives and workstreams, ensuring Paid Search thinking is represented in agency-wide transformation, operational improvement, product development and thought leadership activity.

•    Bring together the appropriate specialists to ensure the development of appropriate client-specific measurement, attribution and technology solutions that solve paid search challenges and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.
•    Cooperate with wider WPP Media teams to elevate search standards, advance the Paid Search practice, shape the search agenda and support delivery of priority initiatives.

Client strategy, proactivity and commercial growth
•    Act as a senior strategic advisor to client stakeholders, helping them understand how Paid Search can support broader business goals rather than operating as a standalone media channel.
•    Lead teams to interrogate client business context, market dynamics, customer behaviour, competitive pressure and commercial objectives, turning those inputs into ambitious but credible Paid Search strategies.
•    Ensure clients receive a gold standard product experience that is strategically progressive, data and technology led, commercially grounded and delivered in line with our product narrative.
•    Cultivate strong client relationships by providing exceptional operational output, clear strategic direction, proactive recommendations and a strong sense of ownership across every account.
•    Identify opportunities for growth across the Paid Search market and within the client portfolio, including new products, new scopes, automation-led efficiencies, performance improvement opportunities and integrated search propositions.
•    Identify and lead opportunities to expand Paid Search into broader Integrated Search and Total Search engagements, connecting SEO, Content, Digital PR, Analytics and wider media capabilities to solve client challenges and drive measurable business outcomes.
•    Ensure commercial objectives are fulfilled, including income growth, profitability, scope management, accurate forecasting and effective finance processes that reduce risk of write-offs, overspends and avoidable queries.
•    Lead Paid Search input into new business activity, codifying processes and reusable narratives that strengthen pitch quality, differentiation and conversion.
•    Support the creation of compelling client narratives that explain the role of Paid Search in a Total Search context. Considering a modern search behaviour, integrated planning, AI-enabled discovery, performance growth and customer decision-making.

Delivery excellence, governance and operational standards
•    Implement best practice across the department by identifying, improving and rolling out processes that raise delivery quality, efficiency, consistency and client confidence.
•    Use automation and new technologies to enhance workflow systems, reduce manual effort, improve QA, support faster insight generation and increase the strategic value of team outputs.
•    Ensure teams apply robust QA, governance, data security, privacy and risk mitigation standards across all clients and delivery processes.
•    Work closely with data and analytics teams to develop sophisticated reporting and measurement frameworks that provide clients with actionable insight, clear performance narratives and business-focused recommendations.
•    Maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional and central teams across the agency, ensuring Paid Search is effectively integrated into wider media planning, performance strategy and client transformation programmes.
•    Work across MM&D UK to ensure Paid Search is connected into overall marketing strategy, client operating models and agency-wide delivery priorities.
•    Act as the point of contact between partners and clients, ensuring clients have appropriate access to support, strategic direction, innovation opportunities and senior escalation routes when required.
Industry leadership, reputation and thought leadership
•    Represent WPP Media at industry events, conferences, seminars and partner forums to showcase thought leadership and strengthen the agency's reputation in Paid Search and modern search.
•    Work in partnership with platforms and industry partners to ensure the agency has an ever-evolving search POV that is practical, differentiated and useful for clients.
•    Develop thought leadership, POVs, case studies, award entries and client-facing narratives that demonstrate the strategic value of Paid Search, Integrated Search and Total Search.
•    Submit and win award entries by identifying exceptional work, shaping strong effectiveness stories and encouraging teams to recognise and codify excellence.

Successful candidates will combine deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, strong client judgement, operational rigour and the ability to inspire teams to deliver exceptional work.
It is essential that you have:
•    Expert-level Paid Search knowledge across Google, Microsoft and broader search ecosystems, with an understanding of emerging search environments, retail media, marketplaces and AI-led discovery behaviours.
•    A proven ability to lead large teams, set standards, manage performance, coach senior talent and build a culture of delivery excellence.
•    Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to map client business challenges to Paid Search priorities, integrated search opportunities and wider growth strategies.
•    A proactive mindset and the confidence to question the status quo.
•    A strong understanding of automation, AI, machine learning and workflow optimisation, with the judgement to apply technology in ways that improve quality, efficiency and strategic value.
•    Confidence working alongside GSO, SEO, Content, Analytics, Commerce, Audience and broader media teams to develop integrated search and Total Search solutions.
•    Excellent client leadership skills, including the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders, shape clear recommendations and translate complex channel thinking into commercially relevant narratives.
•    Immaculate attention to detail and a strong commitment to governance, QA, data security, privacy and financial control.
•    Experience developing products, frameworks, operating models, best practice guidance, thought leadership, award entries or pitch narratives.
•    A strong external perspective, including awareness of industry trends, innovation, platform developments and changes in consumer search behaviour.
•    Commercial acumen, with experience identifying growth opportunities, managing resource, protecting profitability and supporting new business activity.

What good looks like in the role
•    Clients see Paid Search as a strategic growth lever, not just an activation channel.
•    The team consistently delivers market-leading work with clear standards, strong governance and proactive recommendations.
•    Automation and AI are used responsibly to improve quality, efficiency, consistency and strategic focus.
•    Paid Search is actively connected with Organic Search, Content, Analytics, Commerce and wider media planning through Integrated Search and Total Search thinking.
•    The client portfolio shows evidence of growth, innovation adoption, improved delivery quality and stronger commercial outcomes.
•    The VP is recognised internally and externally as a leader who shapes the future of Paid Search, contributes to MM&D UK priorities and raises the standard of search delivery across the agency.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

This role is based in London and candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. Taskrabbit is a hybrid company, with employees working 2 days per week in our dedicated office space in Central London (Soho). 

 

About the role:

The Globalization team sits within the Product organization and ensures the Taskrabbit experience is fully localized and culturally resonant across all our international markets: Canada, the UK, France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, and Italy. We are growth partners and brand guardians for Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and Tasker Operations, among many other departments, elevating brand recognition and unlocking net revenue everywhere.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Localization Specialist to join the team, managing all localization needs with expertise on the Italian locale. In this role, you will balance global localization project management across all markets, including high-touch, complex requests outside our automated pipeline, with full ownership of your language. You will be a strategic architect of our international presence: serving as the cultural bridge between our global product and the Italian market, ensuring our mission to transform lives feels assolutamente autentica, and collaborating with the wider Italian team to bring a strategy to life. You will coordinate translation work with our dedicated external agencies and contractors, and you will also adapt, proofread, edit, or transcreate content. Ideally, you will also contribute creatively to content development by writing original copy.

You will own the evolution of our linguistic assets with the rest of the Globalization team, including glossaries, style guides, but also multilingual guidelines and resources used by all departments. As an internal consultant, you will support stakeholders with expert guidance on cultural nuances and globalization best practices across all territories.

As part of our small but mighty international team, you will enjoy the autonomy to truly shape your role while exploring and implementing innovative tech solutions. Taskrabbit is a data-driven and values-driven company; your work will have a direct impact on the progress of our business and the lives of the communities we serve across all our markets.

  • Manage global localization workflows on Smartling across all markets and locales, with dedicated in-house oversight and review for Italian.
  • Orchestrate work with our dedicated translation agencies and build deep, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Perform Quality Assurance checks to ensure our comms, resources and UX are of the highest standard and they adhere to our linguistic assets.
  • Adapt and/or review content directly on our TMS (Smartling).
  • Test and assess AI-driven workflows to scale our operations and improve efficiency, while maintaining localization quality.
  • Carry out comprehensive localization audits, testing the full user journey to remove friction and enhance the customer experience and our performance metrics.
  • Project manage cross-functional international initiatives, working with remote teams in different areas and time zones.

 

What we are looking for:

  • An Italian localization expert.
  • A passion for language, communication, and storytelling.
  • A minimum of 5 years hands-on localization experience, with a strong background in translation, linguistics, transcreation, content creation, QA, and cultural adaptation.
  • Excellent communication and organization skills. You are capable of carrying out all duties in a fast-paced environment as part of a hybrid international team.
  • Solid understanding of CAT tools, including familiarity with MT and AI-driven workflows and tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to move from reactive translation management to proactive global strategy, identifying and solving complex workflow and content challenges.
  • An experienced project manager, capable of working cross-functionally, managing expectations, understanding priorities, and delivering on time.
  • A seasoned specialist who understands the nature, needs and nuances of different content types: Marketing, Product and Engineering, Customer Support, Partnerships, etc.
  • A forensic eye for detail and a strong curiosity about how things work.
  • A clear, kind, and considerate professional who takes pride in a job well done.
  • A team player—You’ll be joining a small, cohesive team.

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks.

This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

  • The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. As an Applied AI Engineer at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor helping tech-forward companies build on the Claude Developer Platform as they grow and scale. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with engineering teams to help them develop their products on top of Claude - advising on implementation, agent design, and working alongside them to build at the frontier of AI.

You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable tech-forward businesses to succeed with Claude.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-growth, tech-forward companies, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI

  • Work hands-on with customer engineering teams: pair programming, architecture reviews, and code contributions that accelerate their development

  • Develop prototypes and technical documentation—including evaluation suites, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams—that enable customers to build and scale with Claude

  • Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements

  • Identify patterns across engagements and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, and the broader Applied AI team

  • Create technical content for developer audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code

  • Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and developer-focused events

  • Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and relationship building


You may be a good fit if you have

  • 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder

  • Experience in a customer-facing or pre-sales technical role - partnering with customers to scope, design, and deliver solutions

  • Production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale

  • Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python and experience building production applications

  • Experience working with high-growth, tech-forward companies

  • Ability to context-switch across industries (healthcare, fintech, etc.) and use cases

  • Builder credibility that earns trust with technical founders and engineering leaders - you've shipped products and can speak from experience

  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans

  • Experience facilitating technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events

  • Passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
£225,000—£255,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will:

  • Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend.
  • Develop in a scalable and multi-tenant architecture.
  • Analyze user needs and discuss technical approaches.
  • Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps.
  • Take part in on-call rotations with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.

You bring:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer working in search.
  • Experience with building search solutions on top of engines, such as Elasticsearch (preferred), Solr, OpenSearch, or similar.
  • Aspiration to constantly improve yourself and learn new technologies, concepts, etc.
  • Fluent English communication skills to work in international teams.
  • AI Aptitude: A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience using modern search stacks and strategies to optimize search relevance (Vector and Hybrid Search, Learning to rank, Re-ranker)
  • Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures (incl., queues, notification topics, sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover).
  • Experience working with Scala or other functional programming languages.
  • Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust. 

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

You’ll report to our Head of Risk and Control and work closely with First Line teams across the business. Our Risk & Control team is highly collaborative and dedicated to driving a culture of sound risk management across Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Operations, Finance, and Compliance to ensure cross-functional success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Risk & Controls Officer, you will:

  • Support Risk Framework Execution – Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of Pleo's 2LOD risk management framework, ensuring controls remain aligned with regulatory expectations and business strategy.

  • Execute Oversight Activities – Conduct RCSAs (Risk and Control Self Assessments) and control reviews across the business. Assess the quality of risk identification and control design, and challenge 1LOD findings where appropriate.

  • Identify & Assess Risks – Support scenario analysis and stress-testing exercises across operational, technology, product, and credit risk domains. Help surface emerging risk exposures to leadership.

  • Be a Reliable Risk Advisor – Support business teams with guidance on risk topics, control requirements, and regulatory change, providing practical recommendations on risk and control issues.

  • Support Risk Reporting & Regulatory Engagement – Contribute to the preparation of clear, data-informed risk reports for senior management and governance committees, and assist with regulator interactions on risk and control matters.

  • Financial Services Experience – 3+ years of experience in a regulated financial services environment (FinTech, banking, payments, or similar) with hands-on experience in risk or control management.

  • Core Risk Domain Knowledge – Proven experience with operational risk, technology risk, and product risk assessment.

  • Hands-On Risk & Control Execution – Background in ERM framework execution, control design, RCSAs, assurance activities, and remediation tracking.

  • Pragmatic, Solutions-Oriented Approach – A real-world problem-solving mindset that delivers workable answers to real risk challenges rather than defaulting to theoretical frameworks alone.

  • You enjoy a pragmatic, hands-on role where risk oversight directly enables business growth and innovation.

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment partnering with cross-functional teams across Product, Operations, and Finance.

  • Your background is primarily in traditional Internal Audit, Consulting, or pure Compliance without direct operational risk framework and RCSA experience.

title: Staff Information Security Manager (w/m/d)
description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Bei uns ist Security kein nachträglicher Checkbox-Prozess, sondern Teil der DNA. Wir bauen Sicherheit dort ein, wo sie wirkt: in Architekturen, Pipelines und Betriebskonzepte. Nachweise sollen aus dem laufenden Betrieb fallen, nicht aus der Auditvorbereitung. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Sicherheitsanforderungen in belastbare technische Konzepte übersetzt und deren Wirksamkeit überprüft. Aufgabenbereich Treibe den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Secure SDLC direkt an der Seite der Dev-Teams voran. Führe Threat Modeling und Architektur-Reviews durch – früh in der Designphase, nicht erst kurz vor dem Release. Entwirf moderne IAM-Konzepte (Rollenmodelle, Berechtigungslogik, Rezertifizierungsverfahren) und definiere kryptografische Standards und Baselines. Verantworte das Vulnerability- und Pentest-Management: Scanning, CVSS-Bewertung, Priorisierung und Remediation-Tracking. Spezifiziere Logging-, Monitoring- und Error-Handling-Anforderungen und begleite deren Umsetzung. Konzipiere und werte technische Business Continuity (BC)- und Wiederanlauftests aus. Automatisiere die Nachweiserhebung (Compliance as Code) direkt in den CI/CD-Pipelines der Teams. Qualifikationen Cloud & Linux Mastery: Mehrjährige, fundierte Praxis mit Linux und moderner Cloud-Infrastruktur (inklusive Containern, Orchestrierung und Netzwerken). Vulnerability Expertise: Praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Scanning, der CVSS-Bewertung und der Triage von Pentest-Findings. Automation Mindset: Sichere Scripting- und Automatisierungsskills (Python, Bash, Infrastructure as Code), idealerweise bereits für die automatisierte Nachweisgenerierung genutzt. Security by Design: Ein sicheres Händchen für Security Design Principles und Threat Modeling. Consulting & Ownership: Starke Beratungs- und Reviewkompetenz. Du setzt Security-Anforderungen bei Dev- und Ops-Teams erfolgreich durch, ohne ihnen die technische Verantwortung zu nehmen. Vulnerability Management: SAST-, DAST- und SCA-Tooling. Zentrale Plattformen: DefectDojo als Vulnerability-Management-Plattform; SIEM- und Monitoring-Plattformen. Identity & Encryption: IAM/PAM und PKI (betrieben von Partnerteams). Evidenzquellen: Tiefe Integration in CI/CD-Pipelines und Ticketing-Systeme zur automatisierten Nachweisgenerierung. Kommunikation: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1 Level). Nice to have Tiefes Konzeptwissen im Bereich IAM (Rollen- und Berechtigungsmodelle, SSO, Federation, PAM, Rezertifizierungslogik). Angewandte Kryptografie in der Praxis (TLS, PKI, Key Management, HSM). Kenntnisse gängiger Frameworks und Standards wie ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A, BSI IT-Grundschutz, OWASP ASVS & Top 10, CIS Benchmarks oder NIST CSF. Berührungspunkte mit Policy as Code und Continuous Compliance. Verständnis für Auditlogik und die erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit mit externen Prüfern. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse. Hinweis zur Bewerbung Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht. title: Masseur / Physiotherapeuth (m/w/d) - Deimann Spa
description: Wenn ein Gast nach einer Behandlung tiefenentspannt den Deimann Spa verlässt, ist genau das der Moment, in dem Ihre Arbeit spürbar wird. Mit fachlichem Können, Ruhe und einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste machen Sie aus einer Massage oder Wellnessanwendung eine wertvolle Auszeit. Im Deimann Spa, dem Wellnessbereich unseres 5-Sterne-Superior-Hotels im Sauerland, verbinden wir professionelle Anwendungen mit herzlicher persönlicher Betreuung. Sie arbeiten in einem hochwertigen Umfeld, in dem Qualität nicht nur bei der Behandlung zählt, sondern auch in jedem Kontakt mit unseren Gästen. Aufgaben Führen Sie klassische und wellnessorientierte Massageanwendungen professionell und mit einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste durch. Setzen Sie Ihr fachliches Wissen bei physiotherapeutischen Anwendungen ein, sofern diese Ihrer Qualifikation entsprechen, und begleiten Sie unsere Gäste verantwortungsvoll auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Wohlbefinden. Beraten Sie unsere Gäste individuell zu passenden Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen und finden Sie gemeinsam mit ihnen die Behandlung, die zu ihren persönlichen Bedürfnissen passt. Erkennen Sie im Rahmen Ihrer fachlichen Qualifikation die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste und stimmen Sie Ihre Behandlung entsprechend darauf ab. Betreuen Sie unsere Gäste während ihres gesamten Aufenthalts im Deimann Spa aufmerksam, herzlich und professionell. Bereiten Sie die Behandlungsräume sorgfältig vor und nach, damit jede Anwendung in einer ruhigen, gepflegten und hochwertigen Atmosphäre stattfinden kann. Sichern Sie durch Ihre sorgfältige Arbeitsweise die hohen Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards unseres Spa-Bereichs. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Spa-Team zusammen und tragen Sie dazu bei, dass unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und persönlich aufmerksam betreut werden. Gestalten Sie mit Ihrer Arbeit ein Spa-Erlebnis, das unseren Gästen Ruhe, Entspannung und die besondere Qualität des Hotel Deimann vermittelt. Arbeiten Sie überwiegend tagsüber bis in die Abendstunden, regulär bis etwa 19:00 Uhr. Auch Sonn- und Feiertage gehören zu Ihrem Arbeitsalltag. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Masseur/in, Physiotherapeut/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, damit Sie unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und verantwortungsvoll behandeln können. Sie bringen idealerweise praktische Erfahrung in Massage, Physiotherapie, Wellness oder einem Spa mit – aber auch als Berufseinsteiger/in sind Sie willkommen, wenn Ihre fachliche Qualifikation und Ihre Haltung zu uns passen. Sie verfügen über fachliche Kompetenz und arbeiten sorgfältig, weil hochwertige Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Präzision erfordern. Sie haben Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Menschen, weil eine gute Spa-Behandlung nicht nur von der richtigen Technik, sondern ebenso von Aufmerksamkeit und Einfühlungsvermögen lebt. Sie arbeiten serviceorientiert und aufmerksam, damit sich unsere Gäste während ihrer gesamten Behandlung persönlich wahrgenommen und bestens aufgehoben fühlen. Sie treten gepflegt und professionell auf, weil Ihr persönliches Auftreten wesentlich zur hochwertigen Atmosphäre im Deimann Spa beiträgt. Sie arbeiten selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst, damit sich unsere Gäste jederzeit auf Ihre fachliche und persönliche Betreuung verlassen können. Sie sind ein Teamplayer und unterstützen Ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen, weil ein außergewöhnliches Spa-Erlebnis nur gemeinsam entstehen kann. Sie bringen Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Sonn- und Feiertagen mit, da unser Spa auch an diesen Tagen für unsere Gäste geöffnet ist. Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse, damit Sie unsere Gäste sicher, aufmerksam und persönlich beraten und betreuen können. Zusammenarbeit

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Mathematik, Physik, Informatik, VWL/BWL mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt oder vergleichbar

  • Hohe Flexibilität: Wenn es im Markt brennt, bist du auch kurzfristig erreichbar

  • Programmierkenntnisse, vor allem Python für Marktdatenanalyse und Prognosen sowie Java für unseren Algotrader
  • Erfahrung mit M7/ComTrader oder anderen Börsen-Handelssystemen
  • Erfahrung in der Vermarktung von Batteriespeichern, Flexibilität oder Regelenergie
  • Statistische Modellierung oder Machine Learning für Preis- und Prognosemodelle
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit echter Perspektive: Je nach Leistung sind Boni, Gehaltserhöhungen und Beförderungen möglich
  • Direkter Hebel: Deine Strategien laufen auf unserer eigenen Handelsplattform mit direktem Börsenzugang, und weil wir die Software selbst bauen, stehen deine Ideen schnell im Test und im Markt

  • Weiterbildungsbudget und Zeit für Fortbildung, ob Sprachkurs, KI-Werkzeuge oder Fachseminar: alles, was dich weiterbringt
  • Workshops, Messen und Konferenzen, z. B. ees Europe in München, E-world in Essen oder WeAreDevelopers World Congress in Berlin
  • 26 Tage Urlaub, sechs Tage mehr als gesetzlich vorgeschrieben
  • MacBook und Firmen-SIM-Karte mit unbegrenztem Datenvolumen bei voller Geschwindigkeit, beides auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Internationales, hochmotiviertes Team mit regelmäßigen Team-Events
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in zentraler, gut angebundener Lage in Dresden

Bewerbung

Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben ist kein Muss, hilft uns aber sehr, deine Ziele und Visionen kennenzulernen. Auch Arbeitsproben (z. B. eine Marktanalyse oder ein Backtest), Empfehlungsschreiben und Zeugnisse sind willkommen.

raw.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 12K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for developing our finance function and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE's next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO and executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable structures, robust planning and management models, and clear governance and reporting processes.
You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will assess growth options, develop financial models and scenarios, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management. In this role, you will work closely with our CFO in New York, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement L1VE's finance architecture with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, business cases, financial models and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage management and investor reporting and further develop relevant KPIs, forecasts and governance structures
  • Manage interfaces with finance administration, accounting, tax advisors, auditors and other external finance partners

Your profile

  • At least seven years of professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role - ideally as Head of Finance, VP Finance, Finance Director or in a comparable position within a startup, scale-up, technology, media or international corporate environment
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modeling and management reporting
  • Sound knowledge of business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Excellent written and spoken English and confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools; German language skills are an advantage

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

description: We are looking for an experienced Lead Enterprise & Solution Architect to shape the architecture of a complex, business-critical application landscape and support its transformation towards a modern, maintainable and AI-enabled target environment. The role combines classical enterprise and solution architecture with strong expertise across applications, data, integration, cloud and emerging AI technologies. You will work closely with business, engineering, data, security and delivery teams as well as external vendors, providing architectural direction from analysis and target design through implementation. Key responsibilities: Assess the existing architecture and define pragmatic target and transition architectures across application, data, integration and technology domains. Translate business capabilities and requirements into solution architectures, system boundaries, technology choices and architectural roadmaps. Define architecture principles, standards, reference architectures and technology guardrails and ensure their application throughout delivery. Assess complex and legacy landscapes, identifying dependencies, technical debt, architectural risks and modernization opportunities. Define data and integration architectures including data ownership, system-of-record principles, APIs, events and interoperability patterns. Design and review scalable, secure and maintainable solutions across modern cloud, platform and application architectures. Identify and architect meaningful uses of AI, Generative AI and agentic technologies, including their integration with enterprise applications, processes and data. Lead architecture decisions and design reviews, document key decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity or inappropriate technology choices. Evaluate technologies, platforms and vendor solutions and provide architectural input into sourcing and RFP processes. Provide architectural leadership throughout implementation, working closely with engineering teams and vendors to ensure architectural intent translates into working solutions. Extensive experience as an Enterprise Architect, Solution Architect, Lead Architect or in a comparable senior architecture role. Broad expertise across enterprise, application, data, integration and technology architecture, combined with a strong understanding of modern software engineering. Proven experience with complex enterprise landscapes, legacy modernization and transformation programs. Strong knowledge of APIs, integration patterns, distributed systems, cloud architectures, data modelling and modern engineering practices. Practical knowledge of Generative AI and agentic AI architectures, including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, orchestration, enterprise data integration, evaluation and governance. Experience defining architecture principles, target architectures, reference patterns and Architecture Decision Records and conducting architecture and design reviews. Strong understanding of non-functional requirements including security, privacy, resilience, performance, scalability, operability and cost. Experience working across multiple teams and vendors and communicating architectural decisions effectively to both technical and business stakeholders. You should be comfortable moving between business capabilities, processes, data models, system boundaries, APIs, cloud platforms and AI architectures. We value pragmatic architectural judgement over methodology for its own sake: the ability to simplify, make clear trade-offs and turn architecture into solutions that can actually be delivered.   • Strong sourcing and candidate outreach capabilities

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
description:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. 

 What we’re looking for 

  • Core experience: You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams. 
  • Technical depth: You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches. 
  • Mindset: You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution. 
  • Collaboration & communication: You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward. 
  • Nice to have: It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments. 

What you’ll get 

  • A team that values ownership, quality, and speed 
  • Close collaboration between product and engineering 
  • Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours 
  • Unlimited vacation 
  • Competitive compensation 
  • A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact 

Equal Opportunity 

We believe in hiring different and diverse talent and providing a safe space where everyone can share their views without fear, where differences are celebrated, and where no one is left out. Inclusive cultures are the foundation for collaboration and innovation within our team.

description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Observability builds end-to-end observability that spans application, infrastructure, database, browser, and mobile. Our Mobile Observability initiative gives mobile developers first-class instrumentation SDKs that capture traces, metrics, logs, crashes, and user sessions. Our solutions aim to be tightly integrated with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. We’re building high-performance, low-overhead SDKs that make it easy for teams to connect mobile signals to backend and infra telemetry for true full-stack visibility.

We value open standards, great developer experience, and doing the hard engineering needed to ship reliable software at scale. You may not meet every requirement below. If this role excites you, please raise your hand.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build and evolve mobile instrumentation SDKs for iOS (Swift / Obj-C), prioritizing performance, stability, and a great developer experience.
  • Design and ship SDK features such as session tracking, crash reporting, sampling strategies, automatic context propagation, and OpenTelemetry integrations.
  • Own projects end-to-end.
  • Break large, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables: design modular solutions, ship MVPs, gather feedback, iterate quickly.
  • Ensure quality: automated tests, CI, documentation, and smooth, backwards-compatible upgrade paths.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, frontend, product, and solutions engineering to ensure cohesive end-to-end observability workflows.
  • Engage with the open-source community: review PRs, discuss design proposals, and help guide external contributors.
  • Mentor teammates, participate in technical design discussions and help shape the mobile observability roadmap.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You’re a motivated self-starter with a bias toward action and the ability to run with poorly defined scopes. You can operate autonomously while being highly collaborative.
  • Strong mobile engineering experience: with iOS (Swift/Obj-C) and, optionally, Android (Kotlin/Java).
  • Demonstrated experience building or maintaining mobile SDKs, platform libraries, or other developer-facing platform code used by external developers.
  • Experience working with performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, network efficiency) and making pragmatic tradeoffs.
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (instrumentation, SDKs, collectors) or experience contributing to/maintaining OTel SDKs or similar telemetry libraries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed team.
  • Coachable, customer-focused, and passionate about developer experience, you can do more than code: you write docs, mentor others, and shape roadmaps.
  • Pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity: you prioritize progress over perfection and iterate quickly based on feedback.

Bonus Points For:

  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries, or other observability OSS.
  • Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter) or building native bindings/bridges.

  • Maintain strong technical involvement: reviewing data models and SQL, guiding architectural decisions, and stepping in hands-on when your team needs unblocking

  • Contribute to AE-wide decisions on tooling, standards and process, helping shape how Analytics Engineering works at Deliveroo beyond your immediate team

  • Proven experience managing a team of ICs, with a track record of developing people, giving hard feedback, and handling typical team situations independently

  • Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap for a domain area and deliver against it with measurable business impact

  • Strong grounding across the modern AE stack (cloud data warehousing, transformation tooling, data modelling, and data quality practices), with the ability to engage credibly on technical decisions and unblock your team

  • Comfortable engaging and influencing at senior business and product level, with experience aligning analytics investment to domain priorities

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members across UK and India
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Financial Reporting & Control team is responsible for the preparation of Tide’s key financial reports, as well as implementing and monitoring controls to safeguard the Group’s financial integrity.  The team plays a critical role in ensuring the financial data is accurate and complete, compliant with regulations and presented clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

As our Senior Financial Controller you’ll report to the Lead Financial Controller and be responsible for our credit products and areas of credit risk at Tide.  It’s exciting times here at Tide, we are scaling and developing our product offering at a phenomenal rate!

As Senior Financial Controller you will

  • Controllership of our proprietary credit offerings over our 3 Tide Capital companies with varying credit products. 
  • Ownership of the month end processes for reporting P&L, balance sheet and cashflow
  • Documenting and reviewing loss provisioning policies for credit risk, fraud and disputes, negative balances and other risk costs.  Ongoing monitoring and reporting of credit risk performance and adequacy of provisioning coefficients and methods.
  • Ensuring strong control of the new APPF fraud legislation, including accurate representation of losses from fraudulent transactions in the P&L and ensuring monthly balance sheet substantiation
  • Ensuring strong control over our members accounts with negative (overdrawn) account balances, accurately reporting our P&L each month and ensuring monthly balance sheet substantiation
  • Working closely with the Tide Credit Services business, product and operations teams to understand the performance of our products and ensure that our transactions are correctly recorded
  • Handling the introduction of new credit lending products along with our new investment product.
  • Working closely with the collections team for overdue loan payments, analyzing performance of recovery efforts.
  • Collaborating with the ongoing monitoring, operations and risk teams to monitor and report cost of risk, resulting from the credit portfolio, negative customer account balances, fraud and disputes, chargebacks, etc.
  • Working closely with the FP&A team to support with analysis, budgeting and forecasting of the credit portfolio and cost of risk.
  • Represent the finance team at the Credit Risk Working Group and Risk and Compliance Committee.
  • Building robust financial control processes and strengthening internal controls.
  • Maintain strong balance sheet controls with monthly substantiation.
  • Maintaining relationships with external auditors, tax advisors and accounting advisors.
  • Collating financial data for the preparation of corporation tax ensuring compliance with tax legislation.
  • Identifying opportunities to streamline and improve accounting processes, operations and systems.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in financial services – preferably in technology-driven & scale-up environments
  • Experience with credit products and provisioning for credit risk essential
  • Strong financial acumen and excellent technical accounting skills. Familiar with accounting standard and disclosure requirements under UK GAAP and/or IFRS
  • Dealt with the statutory audit of financial services company
  • Hold a professional finance qualification
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Thrive work with minimal hands-on management
  • Meticulous attention to detail
  • Comfort in taking responsibility for business-critical financial operations
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Motivated by Tide’s values and mission 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

  • Competitive Compensation -  competitive salary 
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. For this role we would expect the role holder to attend our Old Street offices at least one day a week.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at

Remote (with Travel around North West UK Territory)

With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

As an Account Executive in the Liverpool Region, you will drive the expansion of our dining network by acquiring new restaurant partners through a consultative sales approach. You will act as a trusted advisor to top restaurants, demonstrating how our industry-leading front-of-house management and online reservation technology can optimize their revenue potential. In this remote position with up to 60% domestic travel, you will play a crucial role in empowering restaurants to focus on their teams and guests. Your strategic efforts will directly influence our market presence and the continued success of the hospitality industry in your territory.

Responsibilities 

  • Identify, target, and approach prospective restaurant customers within your assigned territory to drive revenue and consistently exceed acquisition targets.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with elite restaurant partners, acting as a strategic consultant to challenge their business perspectives and offer industry insights.
  • Deliver high-quality, customized, data-driven demonstrations of our solutions in person and online to address specific partner needs.
  • Develop comprehensive business plans to define selling strategies, overcome competitive objections, and drive long-term business value.
  • Utilise Salesforce effectively to manage your territory, forecast sales activity, process contracts, and stay organized.
  • Gather and present valuable customer feedback to product and marketing teams while maintaining visibility in the hospitality industry through networking.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in business-to-business (B2B) enterprise sales.
  • Drive with a full UK driving license and access to a car
  • Proven track record of goal-oriented sales performance, including outbound lead generation and pipeline management.
  • Proficiency with CRM software (such as Salesforce) and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with up to 60% domestic travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Prior sales experience within the food and beverage industry.
  • Strong ability to leverage data and analytics to inform strategic decision-making and build compelling business cases.
  • Exceptional time management, discovery, and negotiation skills.
  • A highly collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous learning and
    hospitality technology.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 5 weeks paid vacation
  • Time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Bike2Work
  • Season ticket loan

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

 

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

 

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

description:
Type: Fixed-term contract (6 months), 30 hours per week
Work Location: Coventry
Pay:  £17 per hour
Licence/Certification: Full valid UK driving licence (required)

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Our mission is to automate and optimise brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company.

We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world.

 

Job Description

We are currently expanding our operations throughout the UK and seeking a dedicated Supply Chain Technician to support our warehouse and logistics operations. This role will primarily involve working standard warehouse hours (days) but may include occasional weekend or evening shifts depending on business needs. As a crucial member of our team, you will be responsible for keeping our camera hardware inventory accurate, picking orders, and repairing equipment ready to return to the field. Physical stamina, attention to detail, and technical aptitude are essential for this role.

This will be a 6 Month contract position, working a minimum 30 hrs per week with a possibility to extend beyond the initial contract.

  • Possibility of weekend or night work
  • Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's license and reliable transportation is required.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Pick orders and prepare pallets for deliveries, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Complete accurate inventory counts and maintain up-to-date stock records
  • Repair cameras and hardware components so they can be returned to the field in good working order
  • Diagnose faults in returned camera hardware and determine repair or replacement needs
  • Onboard/scan products into the system as required
  • Maintain accurate records of work performed, parts used, and time spent, using company-provided tools
  • Operate warehouse equipment (e.g. pallet trucks, hand tools) safely and efficiently
  • Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines to minimise risks during warehouse operations
  • Work collaboratively with team members to ensure timely completion of orders and repairs
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail to ensure inventory and repair work meets quality standards
  • Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members to provide updates on progress and flag any issues or challenges
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures at all times

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in a warehouse, supply chain, inventory, or technical repair role
  • Strong technical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware issues efficiently
  • Experience with pallet preparation, order picking, and inventory management processes
  • Physical Stamina: Strong physical stamina to work on feet and perform physically demanding tasks for extended periods (up to 9 hours)
  • Detail-Oriented: Excellent attention to detail to ensure inventory counts and repair work meet quality standards
  • Time Management: Ability to work well under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks
  • Communication Skills: Effective communication skills to liaise with supervisors and team members, providing updates on progress and addressing any issues
  • Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's licence preferred
  • Ability to work occasional weekends or evenings as needed
  • Ability to work nights and weekends

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior National Account Manager to lead and grow Myprotein’s presence within the UK Convenience channel. This role will be responsible for developing strategic partnerships with key convenience retailers and wholesale groups, delivering sustainable sales growth, and expanding distribution across a fast-growing category.

The successful candidate will have strong FMCG or consumer health experience, a proven track record managing national retail accounts, and the ability to build long-term customer relationships in a highly competitive market.

  • Analyse sales data, market trends, and customer insights to drive commercial decision-making.
  • Manage forecasting and promotional planning to maximise availability and minimise risk.
  • Build strong relationships with buyers, category managers, and key decision-makers across the convenience landscape.
  • Support the expansion of Myprotein’s retail footprint within emerging convenience and impulse channels.
What skills and experience do I need for this role?
  • Proven experience in National Account Management within FMCG, sports nutrition, beverages, health & wellness, or snacking categories.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Convenience retail landscape.
  • Experience managing major convenience, wholesale, or impulse retail accounts.
  • Demonstrated success delivering revenue growth and commercial targets.
  • Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong analytical and forecasting capability.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commercially minded with an entrepreneurial approach to growth opportunities.

Desirable Experience

  • Existing relationships with UK convenience retailers and wholesalers.
  • Experience within challenger brands or high-growth businesses.
  • Knowledge of sports nutrition, functional health, or performance products.
  • Experience working with Booker, Co-op, Spar, WHSmith Travel, Bestway, or similar retail groups.

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Develop your expertise through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service. 
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12 months 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP. 
  • Access our 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), which is provided by Bupa. 
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym. 
  • Access to our on-site physio. 

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office. 
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 
  • On-site staff shop.
